hotel_name: Hotel Delhi Airport Plaza (Complimentary One-Way Airport Transfer)

positive_snippets:
The Hotel is located near Mahipalpur flyover bridge approximately 300-400 m from the traffic signal.

The hotel lobby is decent and normally one more receptionist is present, I found the staff to be polite and helpful.

The room I got last time had a great outdoor seating available which I found quite interesting.

Recommended

negative_snippets: This is going to be the longest review I have written & probably never written a bad review ever. I book cheap places, because they offer what they have & sometimes, I am just looking for a clean bed & bathroom, that's it. So, let me start with check in. I meet a girl at check in, who gives me room 206 at around 2 pm. There is no room to the key & several people disturb me when I am there to sort out the room key thing. The bed is REALLY NICE for the price & I get a good sleep there. BATHROOM IS DIRTY BLACK & no one has attempted to change. The sheets have not been changed, (but I do not have a problem with it). I see the previous person's hair all around the bed & I am absolutely OK with this. Then until 7 pm, when I do not get the room key, I ask & the girl & the hotel owner tell me that it is totally safe to leave my belongings in my room without lock & key, since the hotel is covered by CCTV. Finally, they change my room. I ask them for an iron box & they say they do not have it. Then, they make me one hour trying to find some one & still don't offer help. When I read my booking carefully, I read IRON BOX in the offerings. Thankfully, a male on duty at night promise to get it to me by 9 AM & he does it. Then when I ask for my complimentary ONE WAY transfer to the airport, they charge me Rs 150 as parking charges. Again, when I ask the girl to give me a receipt of Rs 150, she gets the complimentary ride.
Very very dirty place. Dirty building. No parking nearby. Rooms are filthy and bathroom seems like never been cleaned.
